description: How the art audit (python scripts/art-audit.py, phobos-modkit's art-audit) reads this repository: where shipped images are, the records beside them, how a record says the picture was made, and borrowings and images accepted as they are. Kinds are decided by the pattern that matches first in a record, so a generated picture whose record mentions the stand-in it replaced stays generated. Accepted entries are agent choices from docs/development/art-backlog.md unless they name the owner; the owner may revise any.
